finding: The focused-tests, high-member-court and known-unsupported-preflight branch names do not contain additional executable test/evaluator/court source; they are exact pointers to the current owner state. Evaluator-control v8 is a durable contract/coordination artifact, not a landed executable court implementation.
decision: Do not infer executable evidence from branch names. The next legitimate Issue206 route must actually land the exact Builder postimage, focused tests, and a source-custodied v8 execution instrument on current development before product timing credit.
anti_duplication: Do not create another named Issue206 branch merely to represent a planned test/court. Reuse the current-development transactional landing branch and add real source/evidence only when the mutation route is available.
